tools.name: health_check
tools.description: Check the health status of the numbrU API

tools.name: list_people
tools.description: Retrieve all people (clients) for the authenticated user. Optionally search by name. Returns contact details only, not the Lowdown: for any read, card or "go deeper", call generate_compass.

tools.name: get_person
tools.description: Retrieve a single person (client) by their ID. Returns contact details only, not the Lowdown: for any read, card or "go deeper", call generate_compass.

tools.name: create_person
tools.description: Save a new person (client) to the user's people list. Only call this when the user asks to save or add someone. Never call it to get a Lowdown, a card, or to go deeper: use generate_compass for every read. Requires the user to have a profession set.

tools.name: batch_create_persons
tools.description: Create up to 10 people (clients) in parallel and generate a Client Compass for each. Use this for re-engaging dormant leads — a name is enough. tools.name: get_chat_messages
tools.description: Retrieve chat message history for a specific person (client). Returns messages in reverse chronological order.

tools.name: send_chat_message
tools.description: Send a chat message about a specific person (client). The AI will respond with tailored advice based on the client's Compass profile.

tools.name: get_me
tools.description: Retrieve the authenticated user's profile information.

tools.name: complete_profile
tools.description: Complete the user's profile (one-time signup). Sets name, profession, and generates a User Compass. Required before creating clients.

tools.name: update_profile
tools.description: Update the user's profile settings. Can change name, profession, phone, DOB, or custom prompt.

tools.name: generate_compass
tools.description: Get the Lowdown on a person from the numbrU engine. Call with depth "card" first (the default): it returns a short card with KNOW, AVOID, and INSTEAD. findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "generate_compass" is 1010 chars, far longer than this server's median (133). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "generate_compass" stacks urgency/override words (important, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "generate_compass" appears informational but accepts parameters (context) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "numbru-mcp-server.numbru.workers.dev" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_chat_messages · Private data: list_people, get_person · Public sink: send_chat_message.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_chat_messages · Private data: list_people, get_person · Public sink: send_chat_message

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
